# Claude desktop-to-mobile events

Checked 2026-09-25 against the official installed Claude Code **2.1.282**,
the official Mods types (generated by 2.1.277), and the user's recovered
2.1.88 source as a historical reference only.

## Interface choice

- [SDK streaming output](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/streaming-output)
  and [CLI flags](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference): print/stream-json
  is a headless interface, not a tap into an existing interactive terminal.
- [Remote Control](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control) connects through
  Anthropic's service; it is not an arbitrary local server for our CF relay.
- [Official Mods](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/tree/main/mods) and
  [engine types](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/mods/types/claude-code.d.ts)
  expose `turn.step` in the same interactive engine. This is an early-access
  surface: validate capabilities, preserve fallbacks, and test the actual CLI.

## Implementation

New supported Claude terminals receive an ephemeral, per-launch `--plugin-dir`
and `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1`. The plugin is validated before launch;
explicitly disabled hooks, existing plugin-dir/headless/remote modes, unsupported
CLIs and managed restrictions retain normal terminal/transcript adaptation.
No user settings, prompts, provider configuration or permission decisions are
rewritten. Input and approval controls still use the original PTY and sequence
guard. The official TUI continues to own the conversation.

The hooks pass every engine chunk and downstream return value through unchanged.
Only main-loop visible text, tool arguments/results, lifecycle and model/context
metadata are mirrored. Opaque envelopes, subagent streams, private thinking,
credentials and unrelated configuration are excluded. `step` completion is not
turn completion: tool execution can continue afterwards. Interruptions do not
mark unfinished tools successful. Clear/resume detach the previous session;
rewind/compact invalidate the live projection until a new turn.

The collector binds only 127.0.0.1 with a per-terminal random bearer capability,
rejects browser origins, and filters fields. Claude's nonessential-network
restriction also blocks loopback HTTP. In that case hooks use bounded local
file IPC under their private temporary directory; the setting is never disabled.
Packet sequence numbers deduplicate a network-to-file handoff. Partial file
writes are retried. Packet/journal gaps or overflow invalidate authority and use
native history/VT until the next turn. Closing the terminal stops the collector
and removes its temporary plugin/files.

The existing authenticated direct/Cloudflare relay transports paginated events
with independent Claude epoch/cursors. Mobile renders original Markdown during
generation, retains the last good view during reconnection, preserves native
history/images/tool outcomes and pins disk handoffs to native user UUIDs once
matched. The status footer persists independently of scrollback. Legacy parsing
also retains SGR emphasis, list boundaries, message IDs and footer state.

## Verification

`claude plugin validate src/claude-mobile` and
`claude plugin test src/claude-mobile` run the plugin with the official engine
(`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1`). The tests cover exact pass-through,
network-policy file fallback and main-loop filtering.

`SINOS_TEST_CLAUDE=claude cargo test claude_stream::tests -- --include-ignored`
includes a real ConPTY TUI with an isolated config, fake key and a loopback SSE
model. It verifies original Markdown arrives before completion with network
restrictions still enabled, and `/clear` detaches the old session. No provider
API turn is sent. Separate tests cover collector authentication, bounded replay,
field filtering, compatibility exclusions, UI streaming/lists, tool lifecycles,
history deduplication, reconnects and approval guards.
